sidereal.housesNote: Houses are WHOLE-SIGN from the rising sign (the lagna), as the Jyotisa lens reads them. Placidus cusps in the same sidereal zodiac are given in housesPlacidus, and each point carries placidusHouse. The nodes (Rahu = North Node, Ketu = South Node) are TRUE nodes; many Jyotisa practitioners use the mean node, which usually differs by under about 1.5 degrees. Aspects here are the Western geometric aspects (identical in both zodiacs); Jyotisa drishti are not computed.

dayReference.note: Days are local calendar days in this zone. A transit is "in orb" on a day when it is within the orb at local noon; "exactToday" when its exact instant falls in that local day. Change DAY_ZONE in build_chart.py to re-cut the days.

config.moon: kept out of inOrb/top3: it moves about 13 degrees a day and would bury every slower transit. It has its own block per day (sign and natal house at noon, sign ingress, exact aspects to natal points that day).

scoring.formula: bodyWeight + aspectWeight + targetWeight + 4*(1 - orb) + 1.5 if exact today + 0.5 if applying
scoring.intent: slow planets first, then exactness; top3 = the three highest scores

config.engine: recursive-astrology api/transit_timeline.py (Skyfield DE421, ecliptic of date, true node) for exact instants, stations and ingresses; Chiron from the JPL Horizons table
config.note: A calendar of geometry, not a forecast. An in-orb item with an empty exacts list does not perfect inside the solved window (about four months either side): it may perfect later, or the planet may station inside the orb without perfecting.
